subject: Encord Intro
text:
Hi [NAME],

[COMPANY]'s name came up during a conversation we had with Aigen at our Physical
AI event last week in SF, so wanted to reach out to see if you'd be open to
a quick chat?

We've recently started working on projects with a bunch of your AgRobotics
peers (i.e. Carbon Robotics, Blue River Technology, Four Growers etc.) to
support the fine tuning of their crop analytics computer vision models -
particularly focused on agentic workflows to automate their annotation
pipeline as they expanded into new customer deployments.

Bit of context on Encord…we're a computer vision scale-up (Series B, $50M
raised) focused on consolidating data curation, annotation, and model
evaluation in one platform.

Would you be open to a quick virtual coffee with our team in the coming
weeks? It'd be great to introduce ourselves & get your feedback on what
we're building. We're pretty open next week Thur/Fri afternoon PT, however
happy to work around your schedule!

text:

I lead a medical team here at Encord (~6 years old, 100+ employees & $50M+ funding) - we're actually working with a few of your peers (Artisight, Stryker, Teladoc, Highmark, etc) on scaling and refining their fall detection and RPM vision models. subject: {Invitation}  Encord's AI Leaders Roundtable in Paris
text:
Hi [NAME],​

Our Head of AI will be hosting an intimate dinner with customers & AI leaders and we would like to invite you. 

Attendees range from Directors of Computer Vision & VPs of AI from larger orgs like AXA, Sanofi, etc as well as CEO's & CTO's of leading VC-backed start-ups such as Deepomatic, Scortex, etc

This intimate dinner will take place on 21st of May at the Maison de L'Amérique Latine restaurant where we have secured a private dining room for ~20 people, starting at 7pm. 

In case you're not familiar with Encord, we raised $50M from CRV/YC and are an end-end data development platform for ML teams from Axa, EuroControl, Moon Surgical, etc. We are consolidating data management, visualisation, and annotation, solution all under one platform. 

Please RSVP to this invite should you wish to secure a spot on the dinner, spots are limited and on a first come, first served basis.

Au plaisir,

Our Co-Founder & Head of US will be hosting an intimate networking event
for customers & AI leaders in the Bay Area - we'd love for you to join if
you're interested / can make it!

We've booked a private lounge at 25 Lusk in SF on Thursday, May 15th,
6:30-9:30 pm, capping attendance to ~30 people (open bar + food
included). Attendees include CxOs & technical leaders from leading
VC-backed scale-ups in the computer vision space - i.e. Skydio, Physical
Intelligence, Standard AI, Verkada & others.

Bit of context on Encord...we're a computer vision scale-up (recently
raised a $30M Series B) focused on consolidating data curation, annotation,
workflow management and model evaluation under one platform.

Thought it'd be a good opportunity to get connected - would you be
interested in joining? I can send over an invite if so.
